description: graphlore: a pointer to the code graph when Grep looks for a name it defines, and a note when a commit or an edit leaves the graph behind. GRAPHLORE_HOOKS=0 turns them off.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && PYTHONPATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src" python3 -m graphlore.hooks pre || true
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && PYTHONPATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src" python3 -m graphlore.hooks post || true
